notes.title: Fighting Fantasy Legends Portal becomes Deathtrap Dungeon Trilogy!
notes.content:
Hey Fighting Fantasy fans! We've just put out the first update for Fighting Fantasy Legends Portal for the first time in a while, so here is what is changing in this update:

[h1]A whole new name![/h1]
In this new version, we've updated in-game content to reflect the new 'Deathtrap Dungeon Trilogy' game title. 'Fighting Fantasy Legends Portal' has always been a clunky title, and when bringing this game over to the Nintendo Switch, we saw an opportunity to change it!

[h1]Removing the Asmodee login[/h1]
We've also removed the Asmodee login system, as we've now gone independent and are self-publishing! This shouldn't effect your game at all, as there wasn't any extra content to synchronise across devices for this title.

[h1]And other smaller changes[/h1]
Thanks to the work we did porting this game, we were able to work out some small bugs and improve the performance of the game.

[h1]Fighting Fantasy on Discord[/h1]
And finally, we've now got a 'Fighting Fantasy' chat area on our Discord. The official Nomad Games discord is full of lovely folk discussing all of our games, and you can chat directly to our development team on there too!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discordapp.com/invite/nomadgames]You can join our Discord here.[/url]
